title: Emergency Severity Index (ESI) Triage Classification Matrix
summary: Standard operating criteria for categorizing arriving emergency cases across ESI Level 1 to 5.
content: ESI Level 1 indicates immediate life threat requiring immediate resuscitation (cardiac arrest, respiratory failure). ESI Level 2 signifies high risk, severe pain, or acute altered mental state needing doctor review within 10 minutes. ESI Level 3 represents hemodynamically stable patients needing two or more diagnostic resources (IV fluids, laboratory panels, CT imaging). ESI Level 4 and 5 indicate single-resource and non-urgent minor ailments.
